title: Ajayakumar @ John vs Nizha.P.@ Marry on 20 December, 2010

paragraphs.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM

Mat.Appeal.No. 577 of 2009()


1. AJAYAKUMAR @ JOHN,
 ... Petitioner

 Vs



1. NIZHA.P.@ MARRY, D/O BALAN NAIR,
 ... Respondent

 For Petitioner :SRI.T.G.RAJENDRAN

 For Respondent : No Appearance

The Hon'ble MR. Justice R.BASANT
The Hon'ble MR. Justice K.SURENDRA MOHAN

 Dated :20/12/2010

 O R D E R
 R.BASANT &
 K.SURENDRA MOHAN, JJ.
 -------------------------------------------
 MAT Appeal Nos.577 of 2009
 and 852 of 2009
 -------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 20th December, 2010

 JUDGMENT

Mat.Appeal No.577/2009 is filed by the

appellant/husband against the dismissal of his claim for

divorce under Section 10 of the Divorce Act. Mat.Appeal

No.852/2009 is filed by the appellant against a decree for

restitution of conjugal rights passed against him by the

Family Court on the application filed by the respondent,

his wife.

2. During the pendency of these appeals, the parties

have settled their disputes. Accordingly, a joint application

for divorce has been filed under Section 10A of the

Divorce Act. That petition was filed on 15.6.2010. That

was received and the matter was adjourned on 16.6.2010

to 20.12.2010.

3. We have heard both counsel. Both spouses have

filed affidavits to confirm that they want the marriage to

be dissolved by mutual consent under Section 10A of the

Mat.A.577/2009
&852/2009 2
 Divorce Act . All requisite formalities under Section 10A 

 have been complied with. The spouses are legally married.

 They have been residing separately for a period in excess

 of two years. They have decided to get their marriage

 dissolved. An application has been filed under Section

 10A of the Divorce Act on 15.6.2010. The waiting period

 of six months under Section 10A(2) of the Divorce Act has

 already elapsed. Spouses have confirmed that they want

 their marriage to be dissolved under Section 10A of the

 Divorce Act. We are satisfied in these circumstances that

 these appeals can be allowed, impugned orders can be set

 aside and divorce by mutual consent under Section 10A of

 the Divorce Act can be granted.

a) Mat.Appeal No.852/2009 is allowed. The

 impugned order is set aside.

b) Mat Appeal No.577/2009 is allowed. The

 impugned order is set aside.

c) I.A.No.1495/2010 is allowed. The marriage

 between the spouses, solemnised as per christian religious

Mat.A.577/2009
&852/2009 3

 rites at the Amalapuri St.Thomas Church, Kozhikode on

 12.5.1999, is hereby dissolved on mutual consent under

 Section 10A of the Divorce Act with effect from this date.

R.BASANT
 JUDGE


 K.SURENDRA MOHAN
 JUDGE
